dispatch_contract.worker_ownership: One worker owns one parent and its ordered children in one isolated worktree by default.
dispatch_contract.child_execution: Sequential by default; parallelize only when Supervisor proves independent children have disjoint file boundaries.
dispatch_contract.scheduling: Respect parent dependencies, P0/P1/P2 priority and FIFO among eligible tasks.
dispatch_contract.completion: All children, owner gates, independent QC and serial merge must pass before parent completion.
dispatch_contract.canonical_runtime_state: Astra One SQLite ledger; these JSON files are immutable planning inputs, not a second live queue.
dispatch_contract.queue_import: Import exactly 247 parents into project_queue; attach child records to parents rather than creating unrelated top-level tasks.
dispatch_contract.security_gate: Every task packet carries ASEL-1.0 security acceptance. Workers cannot disable scanners, suppress findings or self-approve. Security findings and scan receipts are reviewed independently by QC.
dispatch_contract.active_scan_scope: Only inventoried owner-controlled repositories, registered hosts, staging APIs and Cloudflare resources; bounded, non-destructive and rate-limited.

constraints.github_actions: Do not trigger remote Actions while monthly quota is exhausted. Use local checks; remote-only acceptance remains deferred, never passed.
constraints.codex_quota: On Codex quota exhaustion, pause without consuming retries and preserve checkpoints. Do not silently substitute models.
constraints.docker_qc: Use local Docker no-network QC where appropriate; it does not prove real Windows/iOS/Cloudflare production behavior.
constraints.existing_repo: Use admindeveloper4562/A.R.C.H.O.N; do not create a duplicate repository.
constraints.security: Fail closed on scanner failure or missing/stale required evidence. Critical findings block release; High findings block by default and require a time-limited owner-signed exception with compensating controls.
constraints.active_scanning: No third-party targets, credential spraying, destructive testing or production DAST without explicit owner authorization.

security_enrichment.notes: Existing parent IDs, dependencies, statuses and canonical runtime SQLite ledger are preserved. Security child tasks attach to existing parents.
